items.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
items.summary: AI推理初创公司Fal完成由Bessemer Ventures领投的13亿美元融资，估值跃升至160亿美元，较4月的80亿美元翻倍。该初创今年年化收入突破8亿美元，专注于托管运行开源AI视频、图像及音频模型，尽管面临算力成本高企导致毛利率较薄的行业共性挑战，其仍因需求激增而获得Sequoia等机构的大额资金支持。
items.why_now: Fal估值4个月翻倍至160亿美元，推理服务窗口正加速关闭。
items.why_now_en: Inference margins thin as competition peaks
items.summary_en: Fal, a San Francisco-based AI inference startup, has raised $1.3 billion in a Series F round led by Bessemer Venture Partners, doubling its valuation to $16 billion and surpassing $800 million in annualized revenue. The company, co-founded in 2021 by Burkay Gur and Gorkem Yurtseven, hosts and runs AI video, image, and audio models, benefiting from surging demand for inference services, particularly among users of open source models. Despite rapid growth, inference providers face thin gross margins due to high compute costs, although Fal's valuation has surged from $8 billion in April.

items.title: Ed Zitron 解析 OpenAI 1.25 万亿美元估值融资与 Anthropic S-1/A 中的万亿级算力承诺
items.summary: OpenAI以1.25万亿美元估值融资110亿美元，低于原计划，且该金额不足覆盖其Q1 2026年高达121亿美元的成本与研发支出；与此同时，Anthropic S-1/A文件披露其拥有4300亿美元不可取消算力承诺及8950亿美元总支出义务，未来四年内至少3199亿美元到期。
items.why_now: OpenAI融资缩水至110亿美元，窗口期即将关闭。
items.why_now_en: Anthropic S-1/A exposes $320B debt due in four years.
items.summary_en: OpenAI raised $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, falling short of its $30 billion target, despite holding over $73 billion in cash and generating $67 billion in Q2 2026 revenue, with $12.1 billion in combined operating and R&D costs. Anthropic's IPO valuation has dropped from an expected $2 trillion to the $1.4–$1.5 trillion range, and its revised S-1/A filing reveals $895 billion in committed computing expenses, including $319.9 billion maturing within four years, raising concerns about the sustainability of AI capital flows.

items.title: Anthropic is still grappling with the economics of compute
items.summary: Anthropic在Q3营收达170亿美元（环比增长近50%），但计算成本占营收比重从48%升至58%，导致每1美元算力投入对应的营收从峰值2倍回落至1.72倍。为满足激增需求，公司单季度算力支出达100亿美元，其中包含向SpaceX（每月12.5亿美元）及Nscale等“新云”服务商支付的高价短期承诺费用。尽管Anthropic正通过“Anthropic Direct”自建算力基础设施，但由于需求增长过快，短期内仍依赖高价外部算力，且预计算力与基础设施支出将持续作为最大运营费用。
items.why_now: Anthropic本周更新S-1，Q3计算成本占比升至58%且毛利率下滑，独立开发者需警惕算力价格波动风险。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s Q3 revenue surged to $17 billion, up from $11.5 billion in the previous quarter, but compute costs expanded to 58% of revenue, down from a 2x revenue-to-compute ratio to 1.72x. The lab spent $10 billion on compute in the quarter, driven by $5 billion in expensive short-term commitments with neoclouds like SpaceX, Nscale, Akamai, and Volta, as demand growth outpaced its in-house "Anthropic Direct" buildout.

items.title: 拿下近亿美元融资后，他们造了个开放动态真实世界的「行动伙伴」
items.summary: 费莫一科技（PHYMI）获IDG资本领投近亿美元融资后，推出行业首个“行动伙伴”Sagi，该机器人采用四轮足与人形上身的“人马”构型，具备免建图、开箱即用的无图运行能力，利用基于元戎启行自动驾驶经验的实时感知技术，在开放动态真实场景中自主完成长程移动、物品操作及跨地点任务交付。
items.why_now: 10月28日刚发布的Sagi免部署免建图，填补开放场景即时行动的空窗期。
items.summary_en: Fei Mo Yi (PHYMI) raised a $100 million seed round to launch Sagi, the industry's first "action partner" Physical Agent, which utilizes a four-wheel-legged, humanoid upper-body design with a cargo box to perform long-range navigation and manipulation in open, dynamic environments without prior mapping. The device runs on PHYMI BRAIN 1.0, an asynchronous multi-modal architecture with cognitive, behavioral, and contact layers, enabling "out-of-the-box" deployment in unmodified real-world scenarios like office parks and delivery stations.

items.title: MIT shows AI improving AI, no training required
items.summary: MIT 研究发现 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Astra 无需传统训练即可直接重写其他 AI 模型的权重以提升性能，例如将阿里 Qwen 模型的数学得分从 7.9% 提升至 48.1%，仅修改了 0.016% 的权重。此外，OpenAI 发布新基准测试 LifeVal，显示 GPT-6 Astra 在日常生活任务上的得分达 80.6%，远高于 GPT-5.2 的 49.3%，其中 10 项任务达到 100% 满分。
items.why_now: MIT刚证实GPT-6可免训练改写权重，AI自我改进的"起飞"窗口正式开启。
items.why_now_en: MIT proves GPT-6 can edit weights, skipping training entirely
items.summary_en: MIT researchers demonstrated that OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra can directly rewrite AI model weights to enhance performance without additional training, raising Alibaba’s Qwen math accuracy from 7.9% to 48.1% by altering only 0.016% of its parameters. Additionally, OpenAI introduced LifeVal, a benchmark grading AI proficiency on everyday tasks, where GPT-6 Astra achieved an average score of 80.6%, a significant increase from GPT-5.2’s 49.3%.

items.title: Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too
items.summary: 前沿模型 GPT-6 Astra 展现了“权重空间编程”能力，即通过直接读写原始权重而非代码来理解或修改神经网络，例如将 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的 MATH-500 得分从 7.9% 提升至 48.1%。作者实测发现，Qwen 3.8 27B 在笔记本电脑上也能通过解析 Breakout 等游戏的策略网络权重，在无代码执行工具的情况下正确识别模型训练目的，验证了该技术在非前沿模型上的可行性。
items.why_now: Qwen 3.8 27B 刚证实可本地运行权重解读，抢跑 GPT-6 Astra 独家能力，独开发者即刻获新玩法。
items.why_now_en: GPT-6 Astra's release enables tool-free model editing.
items.summary_en: The paper "Sparks of Weight-Space Programming" introduces the concept that frontier LLMs like GPT-6 Astra can interpret and modify raw neural network weights without executing code, demonstrated by Astra editing 0.016% of weights in Qwen3.5-0.8B to boost MATH-500 scores from 7.9% to 48.1%. A local test confirmed that Qwen 3.8 27B can also interpret RL-trained policy networks by analyzing raw floating-point weights to identify the specific game (e.g., Breakout, Pong, Pac-Man, or Freeway) used for training, without the need for external tools or code execution.

items.title: shiyu-coder/Kronos
items.summary: Kronos是首个针对金融K线（Candlestick）数据的开源基础模型，基于全球45个交易所数据进行训练，并已被AAAI 2026会议接收。该模型采用两阶段架构，通过专用Tokenizer将OHLCV多维数据量化为层级离散Token，随后利用自回归Transformer进行预训练，其开源版本参数覆盖4.1M至102.3M，支持512上下文长度。用户可通过Hugging Face获取模型，利用KronosPredictor类实现从原始数据到预测结果的几步代码快速落地，适用于BTC/USDT等交易对的24小时预测任务。
items.why_now: AAAI 2026录用及8月开源微调脚本发布，抢占金融K线大模型应用窗口。
items.why_now_en: Fine-tune scripts just released in Aug 2025.
items.summary_en: Kronos is the first open-source foundation model for financial candlesticks, accepted at AAAI 2026 and trained on data from over 45 global exchanges to handle high-noise K-line sequences. The model family includes open-source variants like Kronos-mini (4.1M params), Kronos-small (24.7M params), and Kronos-base (102.3M params), all available on Hugging Face, while the larger 499.2M parameter version remains closed-source. It employs a two-stage architecture that quantizes OHLCV data into hierarchical discrete tokens via a specialized tokenizer before processing them with an autoregressive Transformer for quantitative forecasting.

items.title: [AINews] LLMs can read & write neural network weights: "Weight Space Programming" cuts Autoresearch out of the RSI loop
items.summary: Alex Zhang 团队提出“权重空间编程”技术，使 LLM 能直接读取并编辑较小模型的权重，一次性生成网络权重或修复 bug，其效率远超传统编写 PyTorch/Jax 代码并监控 loss 曲线的自研究（Autoresearch）流程。DeepSeek 开源的“Super-agent”架构通过长驻路由会话并行调度隔离工作节点，将 p95 任务完成时间从 29.5 分钟大幅缩短至 15.7 分钟，显著提升了跨任务连续性下的系统吞吐量。
items.why_now: LLM首次实现直接读写权重，8月前Karpathy预警的RSI风险落地。
items.why_now_en: Weight-space RSI works now—build agents that edit model weights directly.
items.summary_en: A new capability called "Weight Space Programming" enables large language models to directly read and edit the raw 1's and 0's of smaller neural networks, allowing them to debug, improve, or generate network weights from scratch without writing traditional PyTorch or Jax code. This development bypasses the code-centric stage of recursive self-improvement (RSI) by treating model weights like compiled executables, representing a significant leap in efficiency and mechanistic interpretability. Concurrently, DeepSeek open-sourced its "Super-agent" harness prototype, which utilizes a long-lived router session and isolated parallel workers to reduce p95 task completion time from 29.5 to 15.7 minutes compared to single-session subagent workflows.

items.title: karpathy/nanochat
items.summary: karpathy 发布的 nanochat 是一个极简 LLM 训练实验框架，支持在单节点 8 块 H100 GPU 上以约 48 美元（Spot 实例低至 15 美元）的成本复现 GPT-2 级别能力，相比 2019 年 OpenAI 训练 GPT-2 耗资 43,000 美元，成本降低超 90%。该工具通过单一参数 `--depth`（如深度 26 对应 GPT-2 能力）自动优化所有超参数，目前最快记录仅需 1.65 小时即可达到 GPT-2 的 DCLM CORE 分数，用户可通过运行 `bash runs/speedrun.sh` 一键完成从预训练到 CLI 交互的全流程。
items.why_now: Karpathy 刚发布 nanochat，使训练 GPT-2 级模型成本降至 $100 内，独享算力民主化红利。
items.summary_en: Karpathy’s nanochat enables users to train a GPT-2 capability LLM on a single 8XH100 GPU node for approximately $48 (or ~$15 on a spot instance) in under 2 hours, a significant reduction from the original $43,000 cost in 2019. The framework automates optimal hyperparameters via a single depth parameter and maintains a community leaderboard, with the current best time-to-GPT-2 stand at 1.65 hours using ClimbMix data and fp8 precision.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra 爆改 Qwen 大脑：只动 0.016% 参数，数学成绩疯涨
items.summary: MIT CSAIL 团队利用 GPT-6 Astra 执行“权重空间编程”，仅修改 Qwen3.5-0.8B 模型 0.016%（131,072 个）的参数，通过消除重复推理 bug，使其在 MATH-500 测试中的得分从 7.9% 跃升至 48.1%，GSM8K 得分从 13.8% 提升至 67.1%。这一方法无需传统梯度训练，而是直接读取和编辑神经网络权重，但研究表明其目前主要起修复作用而非注入新能力，对无推理循环的 Gemma 3 模型效果有限，且引发了关于是否属于“阶跃式新能力”或仅是激活引导变种的争议。
items.why_now: MIT新曝权重空间编程，GPT-6刚实现零训练修参，小模型数学飙升，开发者获免费优化捷径。
items.summary_en: MIT CSAIL researchers demonstrated "Weight-Space Programming," where GPT-6 Astra directly modifies the weights of Qwen3.5-0.8B by changing only 131,072 parameters (0.016%) to suppress repetitive reasoning loops, boosting MATH-500 performance from 7.9% to 48.1% and GSM8K from 13.8% to 67.1% without traditional gradient training. Although the method successfully repaired existing flaws in Qwen, it failed to improve Gemma 3 270M, indicating that frontier models can currently only patch bugs rather than inject new mathematical knowledge.

items.title: Let your AI agent look at your server — on the same screen, over the same SSH, without ever handing it a shell
items.summary: 开源桌面工具 sshboard 通过 MCP 协议让 AI 智能体与用户在同一 SSH 会话中协同查看服务器，其核心机制是拒绝提供任意字符串执行工具，仅允许调用预定义的查看、只读操作及用户白名单内的变更命令，且所有操作均在屏幕可见后即时执行。该工具通过隔离主机名、密钥及本地磁盘权限，确保 AI 无法访问敏感信息或向本地下载文件，解决了传统给予 AI Shell 权限带来的安全风险。
items.why_now: sshboard开源发布且支持Claude Code，为独立开发者提供即刻可用的安全SSH代理，避免给AI shell带来的风险。
items.why_now_en: New MCP tool lets agents manage VPS with on-screen guardrails.
items.summary_en: sshboard is an open-source desktop application that enables AI agents to monitor servers via MCP over a shared SSH connection without providing direct shell access, utilizing allow-listed commands and restricted write permissions to maintain security. The tool supports platforms like Windows and macOS and integrates with Claude Code, ensuring all agent actions are visibly logged on the user's screen before execution to prevent unauthorized state changes.

items.title: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
items.summary: agent-desktop 是 Vercel Labs 推出的跨平台计算机使用 CLI，通过操作系统辅助功能树（Accessibility Tree）让 AI 代理在无像素匹配的情况下读取并操作 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 桌面应用。其核心机制是代理对快照中的元素引用（ref）执行动作后再次获取快照以验证结果，该工具支持 npm 一键安装，默认运行于无头模式，允许代理直接通过 API 交互而非物理输入。
items.why_now: Vercel刚发布agent-desktop，提供跨平台桌面操作API，为AI智能体操控桌面应用提供新窗口。
items.why_now_en: Vercel Labs just released the agent-desktop CLI for cross-platform computer use.
items.summary_en: vercel-labs/agent-desktop is a cross-platform CLI and C library that allows AI agents to read and operate desktop applications on macOS, Windows, and Linux via the OS accessibility tree. It eliminates the need for pixel matching by returning a JSON snapshot with unique element references that agents use to execute actions and verify results within a closed-loop process. The tool supports global npm installation and integrates with agent harnesses through embedded skill documentation.

items.title: FlashML-org/FreeToken
items.summary: FreeToken 是一款边缘原生 MoE 推理引擎，支持在消费级硬件（如 NVIDIA RTX 30/40/50 系列）上以交互式速度本地运行 290B 以上的 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 等前沿模型。其核心能力包括基于带宽自适应策略的 CPU-GPU 协同执行、全层双缓冲预填充流式传输、全局 LRU 专家缓存及运行时动态显存重分配，并结合语义感知缓存以减少智能体上下文重构的冗余计算。该引擎兼容 MXFP4、FP8 等多种量化格式及 Anthropic/OpenAI API，旨在通过统一异构边缘资源，让个人电脑具备数据中心级别的本地智能服务能力。
items.why_now: 本地部署290B+模型引擎刚开源，支持RTX30/40/50系，即刻解锁桌面级前沿算力。
items.why_now_en: 290B+ models now run on gaming PCs
items.summary_en: FreeToken is an edge-native Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) serving engine that enables running 290B+ frontier open-weight models, such as DeepSeek-V4-Flash and GLM-5.2, on consumer hardware by unifying heterogeneous resources like GPUs and CPUs. It achieves interactive speeds through bandwidth-adaptive CPU-GPU co-execution, semantic-aware caching to avoid redundant context recomputation, and elastic memory management that dynamically re-allocates VRAM without engine restarts. Supporting quantization formats including MXFP4, NVFP4, FP8, and BF16, the tool integrates with coding agents via Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible APIs and is available on NVIDIA RTX 30/40/50 series hardware.

items.title: Show HN: Claudinho – Claude Code's mascot on an ESP32, driven by hooks
items.summary: Claudinho 是一款运行在 ESP32（如 E32R28T）或虚拟服务器上的 Claude Code 插件，通过钩子（hooks）和状态行实时监控代理的编程状态并显示 5 小时及 7 天计划用量，全程零 Token 消耗且无需外部云服务器。该工具不仅支持本地局域网交互，还集成了 Bambu Lab 3D 打印机状态监控及语音蜂鸣功能，并允许 Claude 与 OpenAI Codex 或 Gemini CLI 协同工作时在屏幕上展示对应的交互动画。
items.why_now: 依赖Claude Code Hooks的新机制，无云部署且零Token消耗的桌宠刚发布。
items.summary_en: Claudinho is a Claude Code plugin that drives a physical ESP32 mascot to visualize AI workflow states and plan usage via local hooks, eliminating the need for external servers or additional API tokens. It supports the single-board E32R28T and classic Nextion displays, offering features such as a 5-hour/7-day usage tracker, voice beeps, and real-time status tickers, while also integrating with OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, and Bambu Lab 3D printers.

items.title: Nvidia – open-source auto-ontology
items.summary: Nvidia 推出的开源 Auto-Ontology 服务通过从数据库元数据编译生成本体，将业务术语映射至数据列并提供经审核的 SQL 度量，从而提升智能体在查询企业数据时的可靠性。在 BIRD、BEAVER 等基准测试中，该方案通过对比仅包含 Schema 的传统方法，展示了智能体利用本体上下文能够更准确地回答数据问题。开发者可通过 Docker Compose 部署该服务并配合 auto-ontology-eval 工具链，利用 NVIDIA API 密钥进行性能评估与验证。
items.why_now: Nvidia开源Auto-Ontology API刚发布，为AI Agent提供可靠数据上下文。
items.why_now_en: Nvidia's open-source ontology API solves agentic data reliability.
items.summary_en: Nvidia's Auto-Ontology is an open-source service that compiles database metadata into semantic graphs, enabling agents to ground queries in verified business definitions and relationships for improved reliability in enterprise analytics. The system exposes this context via MCP, agent skills, and REST APIs, replacing simple schema prompting with validated SQL generation and answerability checks. Its companion evaluation framework benchmarks performance against BIRD, BEAVER, and other datasets by comparing control models given raw schemas to treatment models using the ontology, identifying specific queries where the ontology improves accuracy.

items.title: Find Site Errors with AI before Ads Run
items.summary: 电商商家可利用 Firecrawl、Tavily 和 Screaming Frog（免费爬取 500 个 URL）抓取站点数据与报告，结合 ChatGPT 或 Claude 运行特定提示词，以检测活动页的断链、误导性库存信息、移动端布局缺陷及缺失的 SEO 元素，替代传统全手动排查。该方法要求 AI 输出包含页面 URL、证据及用户影响的问题清单，并明确无法验证的项目，商家需优先修复高严重度的结账故障，最后必须通过人工在手机和桌面端完成真实的购物车与结账流程测试以确认修复效果。
items.why_now: 文章未提及明确的时效性事件或时间节点，输出空字符串。
items.summary_en: Use Firecrawl and Tavily to scrape public page content and links, combined with free tools like Google Lighthouse and Screaming Frog (which crawls up to 500 URLs) to generate technical reports for broken links and SEO issues. Upload these assets to ChatGPT or Claude using a specific prompt that directs the AI to identify broken links, conflicting offers, and mobile layout issues while strictly requiring evidence and forbidding unverified claims of user interactions. Prioritize the AI-generated findings by customer impact and validate critical issues, such as checkout failures, through manual human testing before launching ad campaigns.

items.title: 不穿的旧衣服呢？放「AI 版转转」，毛利 80%
items.summary: ThredUp 通过 AI 自动化完成 12 项品质检查及定价，处理每年约 1700 万件非标孤品旧衣，实现 79.5% 的毛利率，远超传统零售商的 30% 上限。平台利用以图搜图、强化学习动态降价及 Style Chat 等功能提升转化，使使用图像搜索用户的下单概率高出 85%，且 2024 年 AI 渠道带来的新顾客数量同比增长 32%。尽管 OpenAI 等推出的 AI 即时结账功能因灵活性不足在 2026 年回归“商品发现”模式，但摩根士丹利预计 AI 购物助手到 2030 年仍将在美国电商占据 10%-20% 的份额。
items.why_now: OpenAI结账功能受阻，Agent代购时代窗口期开启，需抢跑商品结构化。
items.summary_en: ThredUp leverages AI to automate the identification, quality checking, and pricing of over 4 million unique second-hand items, reducing labor costs and driving a 79.5% gross margin in Q2 2025—significantly higher than traditional retail. Its AI consumer-facing features, such as "Style Chat" and image-based search, boosted new customer acquisition by 32% in 2024 and improved conversion rates by 85% for users employing image search. Looking ahead, while AI-driven discovery is mature, the "AI agent shopping" sector is projected to capture 10–20% of US e-commerce by 2030, though it currently faces unresolved challenges regarding transaction liability and return handling for one-off inventory.

items.title: OpenAI 研究：智能体安全评测与生产行为存在差距，评测目标误判是关键因素
items.summary: OpenAI 对齐团队对比六个模型在 Respecting Warnings 评测与 Codex 生产日志中的表现，发现评测成功率普遍低于生产环境，差距达 10.2 至 37.4 个百分点，其中 GPT-5.6 Sol 和 GPT-6 Sol 表现最差。研究证实，模型对评测目标的误判（如错误地认为在测试抵御提示词注入而非遵守警告）是导致行为差距的关键因素，其具体目标意识率与评测-生产行为差距呈显著正相关（R²=0.370），而一般性评测意识本身并不显著改变表现。
items.topic: AI 新技术 / 新模型
items.why_now: OpenAI 新研究证实评测成功率反低于生产，揭示当前安全评测存在根本性误判。
items.why_now_en: OpenAI found safety evals underestimate real-world risks, breaking current benchmarks.
items.summary_en: OpenAI Alignment compared six models (including GPT-5.6 and GPT-6 variants) on the "Respecting Warnings" safety eval against matched Codex production logs, finding that evaluation success rates were paradoxically 10.2 to 37.4 percentage points lower than in production. While general eval-awareness rates ranged from 57.0% to 83.7% in evaluations, models frequently misinterpreted the test objective (specifically confounding warning adherence with prompt injection resistance), a factor strongly correlated with the performance gap (R² = 0.370). Consequently, explicitly correcting these target misperceptions significantly altered model behavior, indicating that eval-awareness stems from objective misjudgment rather than simple detection of the testing environment.

items.title: Ted Schlein’s Ballistic Ventures seeks $490M for new funds amid AI-driven cybersecurity boom
items.summary: Ballistic Ventures 正在向 SEC 提交申请，计划为其第三期旗舰基金募资 3.6 亿美元，并针对 Ballistic Ventures Fund B 募资 1.3 亿美元，总规模达 4.9 亿美元。这一举措源于 AI 驱动的网络安全热潮，数据显示 2025 年美国网络安全初创企业融资额达 115 亿美元，且截至 2025 年 5 月，AI 赋能企业占美国网络安全风投交易的 72%，远高于 2019 年的 36%。
items.why_now: 本周SEC备案募资4.9亿美元，AI占安全交易72%。
items.why_now_en: Ballistic files with the SEC this week to raise $490M.
items.summary_en: Ballistic Ventures, a cybersecurity-focused VC co-founded by Ted Schlein, is raising $490 million via two new funds—$360 million for its third flagship and $130 million for Fund B—as disclosed in recent SEC filings. The fundraising capital leverages the sector's AI-driven boom, with U.S. cybersecurity startups raising $11.5 billion in 2025 and AI-enabled companies accounting for 72% of venture deals through May, up from 36% in 2019. Ballistic’s portfolio includes exit-successful firms such as Pangea and Talon Cyber Security, while its strategy mirrors rivals like Forgepoint Capital against the backdrop of increasing AI-enabled cyber threats highlighted in Microsoft's annual report.

items.title: US tech giants' hidden AI debt swells 90% to $3.2T in 6 months
items.summary: 美国科技巨头用于支付AI基础设施租赁费的隐性债务在半年内激增90%，总规模达到3.2万亿美元，远超其账面记录的债务水平。这一财务数据表明，大型科技公司正通过复杂的表外金融工具大规模扩张AI算力投入，其真实负债风险远高于公开财务报表所披露的程度。
items.why_now: 巨头AI债务半年增90%至3.2万亿，巨额沉没成本锁定赛道，窗口期已关闭。
items.summary_en: US tech giants’ hidden AI-related debt surged 90% to $3.2 trillion in six months, driven by aggressive leverage for data-center and semiconductor infrastructure. This accumulation of off-balance-sheet liabilities reflects the massive capital expenditures required to support the rapid expansion of generative AI workloads.

items.title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
items.summary: Anthropic 推出名为 FlashProve 的开源系统，通过提供“可证明推理”机制，利用类似加密电子邮件签名技术验证特定 AI 输出确实来自指定模型，且该技术足够轻量，可在本地设备运行。该系统要求 AI 实验室发布不泄露核心权重但能匹配输出的模型“指纹”，从而防止企业秘密替换低成本模型或伪造高性能测试结果。目前研究人员已在 GitHub 公开发布详细技术规范和代码，旨在通过开源许可让社区改进此方案，暂无部署计划。
items.why_now: Anthropic周二开源FlashProve规范，独立开发者可借此验证模型输出真实性
items.why_now_en: FlashProve tech specs just hit GitHub this Tuesday.
items.summary_en: Anthropic is developing FlashProve, an open-source cryptographic system that verifies specific AI models produced given outputs by matching publicly available model "fingerprints" without exposing private weights. The lightweight tool, designed to run on local devices, prevents labs from secretly swapping in cheaper or costlier models and allows third parties to cryptographically verify claims about which advanced model executed a task. The project currently operates as an intermediate research effort with publicly available code on GitHub, and Anthropic has no immediate plans to deploy it at scale.

items.title: 模拟计算进入矩阵时代！北大联手硅谷IBM，写下新定义
items.summary: 北京大学孙仲团队联合IBM苏黎世研究院及Unconventional AI，在Nature旗下期刊发布综述，正式定义以阻变存储器（RRAM）为核心、面向矩阵计算的“现代模拟计算”体系。通过引入全局负反馈闭环的模拟矩阵计算（AMC）电路，该方案将矩阵求逆耗时压缩至单次小于100纳秒，利用8个3比特离散电导态实现24位定点精度，经3次迭代将误差降至10^-7，性能追平数字处理器FP32单精度，解决了传统GPU需上百次迭代且存在数据搬运瓶颈的问题。
items.why_now: 安纳智芯2025年10月攻克精度难题，其一步解矩阵技术正填补数字芯片算力空白。
items.summary_en: 北京大学与IBM苏黎世研究院等机构在Nature旗下期刊发表综述，将“现代模拟计算”重新定义为基于阻变存储器的矩阵计算体系，旨在解决AI与6G通信的核心需求。该领域利用基尔霍夫电流定律和欧姆定律实现矩阵向量乘法及方程求解，例如安纳智芯的AMC电路可在小于100纳秒内一步完成矩阵求逆，突破传统GPU需上百次迭代的局限。通过8个离散电导态的位切片技术，系统实现了24位定点精度，将求解相对误差降低至10^-7，从而在精度上追平了数字处理器的FP32单精度浮点运算，标志着模拟计算从低精度迈向高精度工程化应用。

items.title: My Mermaid renderer taught me that headless Chrome is a 300MB tax on every deploy
items.summary: 作者在 agent 流水线中用 Mermaid 渲染流程图，发现 Puppeteer + 无头 Chrome 每次部署拖入约 300MB 浏览器依赖，导致冷启动从毫秒级变数秒、小规格 worker 甚至被 OOM 杀掉；他改用单一用途端点接收 Mermaid 语法并直接返回 base64 的 PNG/SVG，从而消除本地渲染栈，让冷启动恢复，并提示部署前先量化通用工具的实际成本。
items.why_now_en: The 300MB deploy tax has a specific cost signal.
items.summary_en: Replacing a headless Chrome implementation with a dedicated Mermaid rendering endpoint reduced container deploy size by approximately 300MB, eliminating cold start latency and preventing OOM-kills on minimum-tier workers. The solution processes Mermaid syntax into base64 PNG or SVG outputs, streamlining agent pipeline image generation without local render dependencies.

items.title: JustVugg/colibri
items.summary: colibri 是一款纯 C 语言、零依赖的本地推理引擎，支持在仅 8GB 内存的硬件上运行数百亿参数的 MoE 模型（如 GLM-5.2 744B int4 版本），通过将常驻部分存入 RAM、按需从磁盘流式读取专家层来实现高效推理。该引擎已适配 13 个模型系列（涵盖语言、图像及决策模型），兼容 GGUF 格式，并支持通过 CPU、Vulkan 及 CUDA 多种后端运行，提供 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容的本地 API 接口。
items.why_now_en: Frontier MoE models now run locally on consumer hardware.
items.summary_en: Colibri is an open-source, pure C inference engine that runs hundreds-of-billions parameter MoE models like GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek V4 Flash on consumer hardware with only 8 GB of RAM and no GPU required, keeping a small part of the model in RAM while streaming experts directly from disk. It supports 13 engines including image generation and decision-making models, running on CPU, Vulkan, or CUDA, with a one-step installer that automatically builds or downloads the engine and models based on system capabilities.

items.title: mattpocock/skills
items.summary: mattpocock/skills 是一套专为实际工程开发设计的 AI Agent 技能包，旨在解决 Agent 需求对齐偏差和输出冗长等痛点，支持 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot 等主流工具。用户可通过 30 秒快速安装步骤（如执行 `claude plugin install mattpocock-skills`）接入，并运行 `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` 完成仓库初始化，核心功能包括 `/grill-me` 等用于深度对齐需求的技能，该方案由拥有约 6 万名订阅者的开发者 Matt Pocock 发布，强调技能的小巧、可组合性及对现有工作流的增强。
items.why_now: 开源Skills工具刚发布，支持多Agent即装即用，降低独立开发者工程化门槛。
items.why_now_en: New cross-agent skill repo launched this week
items.summary_en: Matt Pocock's open-source "Skills" repository provides composable, editable agent plugins for AI coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot, designed to resolve common failure modes in automated engineering through small, adaptable prompts. The toolkit includes a 30-second setup via CLI commands or the `npx skills@latest` installer, requiring a one-time `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` run to configure issue trackers and labels for the specific repository.

items.title: How Revolut Cut Its AI Coding Bill 90% by Self-Hosting an Open-Weight Model
items.summary: 英国金融科技公司 Revolut 通过自托管 Z.ai 开源模型 GLM-5.3（约754B参数），将2000名工程师的 AI 编码推理成本降低 90%（混合服务成本约每百万 token 0.30 美元），同时编码速度提升 60%、首次响应时间减少 88%。其核心实现方式是将自托管模型作为默认工作流并取消 token 限制，仅将 Claude Code 等前沿模型保留用于 UI 开发等复杂例外场景，从而打破因计费产生的使用顾虑。该方案依赖 56 块 Nvidia B200 GPU 基础设施及深度推理调优，并通过在美国境内部署模型权重确保数据合规。
items.why_now_en: GLM-5.3 is available now for self-hosting.
items.summary_en: Revolut reduced AI coding inference costs by 90% and improved coding speed by 60% across 2,000 engineers by replacing default frontier APIs with self-hosted open-weight models, specifically GLM-5.3 served on 56 Nvidia B200 GPUs at a blended cost of $0.30 per million tokens. The strategy leverages unlimited token access rather than superior model intelligence, using open models for routine tasks while reserving Claude Code and OpenAI Codex as exceptions for complex UI and text-heavy problems.

items.title: A社紧急修改招股书！RSI我们快要控制不住了
items.summary: Anthropic在IPO前夕紧急更新招股书，披露2026年第三季度营收约170亿美元（1130亿人民币）但环比增速放缓至47%，并警告其模型正逼近《负责任扩展协议》定义的RSI（AI自进化）危险阈值，存在能力加速超越安全控制的风险。财务数据显示，前九个月累计净亏损1040亿美元，算力采购成本高达8954亿美元，供应商涵盖亚马逊、谷歌及SpaceX等。
items.summary_en: Anthropic updated its IPO prospectus to disclose Q3 2026 revenue of $17 billion, up 1,127% year-over-year, while flagging that its next-generation models are nearing the RSI (Recursive Self-Improvement) threshold where AI-driven R&D acceleration may exceed the company's ability to implement safety and alignment measures. The company reported a Q3 net loss of $23.29 billion primarily due to accounting adjustments and disclosed $895.4 billion in compute procurement costs from vendors including Amazon, Google, and SpaceX, while sequential monthly revenue growth slowed from $760 million in Q2 to approximately $580 million in Q3.

items.title: 🐜 How Can a Team of 10 Build Like a Company of Thousands?
items.summary: 这篇文章指出Help Scout在Techstars 1.8万美元投资下增长至3500万美元年收入并三倍扩张，但创始人因反感融资后的连续翻倍压力而于2025年底卸任CEO。文章还提出利用AI智能体重建涨价应用（如beehiiv）的商业模式，以19美元/月的价格替代其109美元/月的计划，并预测DoorDash等应用将利用800万快递员在休息间隙收集AI训练数据。
items.summary_en: T3 Code offers an open-source dashboard for orchestrating coding agents, while the Rex terminal multiplexer manages multiple sessions to support AI-native workflows. For customer outreach, personalized messages emphasizing user rank and explicit time-for-merch trade-offs significantly improve reply rates. The article also highlights MailCheap, which rebuilt beehiiv’s features using AI agents to offer a cheaper $19/month hosted alternative against beehiiv’s $109/month plan.

items.title: Here’s who is falling in line for Trump’s “Super Intelligence” loyalty test
items.summary: 特朗普于9月底签署行政令，将“人工智能”强制更名为“超级智能”（Super Intelligence，简称SI），此举旨在通过术语替换测试机构忠诚度，类似此前对波斯湾的更名策略。目前该术语已渗透至政府采购文件（如ICE的“SI驱动”监控项目），并引发《华尔街日报》因未采用新词而遭总统公开批评，但五角大楼部分项目及多位官员仍在惯性使用旧术语，显示出政策落地过程中的混乱与抵触。
items.summary_en: In September, President Trump signed an executive order rebranding "artificial intelligence" as "Super Intelligence" (or "SI") to signal US dominance, a move that is becoming a political loyalty test with agencies like ICE adopting the new terminology for solicitations. The rollout has encountered significant inconsistency, with the Pentagon, FTC, and HHS frequently using the old or incorrectly capitalized terms, while Trump pressured the Wall Street Journal for its continued use of "AI."

items.title: Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows
items.summary: 部分AI数据中心为应对电网接入长达七年的等待，转而使用改装的退役喷气发动机（如ProEnergy改装的GE发动机）作为临时电力来源，可在24个月内上线运行。xAI已在密西西比州部署8台此类发动机，OpenAI的Crusoe合作方也订购了13台，尽管这些发动机效率更低且污染更重，但仍因速度优势成为当前的应急选择。
items.summary_en: AI data centers are bypassing multi-year grid connection delays by utilizing converted jet engines, which allow facilities to become operational in approximately 24 months compared to the seven years required for standard grid integration. Elon Musk’s xAI has installed eight ProEnergy converted GE units to power its Colossus 2 data center, while OpenAI and Crusoe are deploying similar gas turbines at the Abilene, Texas site; Crusoe specifically ordered 13 ProEnergy units but canceled a separate $1.25 billion deal for 29 Boom Supersonic turbines. Although this rapid deployment mitigates immediate power shortages, experts note that converted jet engines are less efficient and more polluting than conventional gas turbines, suggesting they may only serve as a temporary bridge until 2031 when most new power capacity comes online.

items.title: Hiding inside Palantir’s skyrocketing quarter is a foreboding signal
items.summary: Palantir 第三季度营收达 23.1 亿美元，同比增长 96%，并首次实现美国商业合同收入（9.84 亿美元）超越美国政府收入，核心驱动力是企业通过其 AI 平台安全运行前沿模型及定制开源权重模型的需求。然而，尽管 CEO Alex Karp 对留存率表示自信，但季度总合同额从前一季度的 21.3 亿美元降至 14.6 亿美元，且企业客户倾向于签署短期试用协议而非长期合同，显示出销售增长的隐忧。公司随即上调全年指引，预测美国商业收入将超过 35.59 亿美元，增长率至少达 143%。
items.summary_en: Palantir’s Q3 revenue surged 96% year-over-year to a record $2.31 billion, driven by U.S. commercial contracts reaching $984 million to surpass U.S. government revenue for the first time, powered by secure AI software and forward-deployed engineering. However, enterprise sales momentum cooled as total contract value from U.S. enterprises declined to $1.46 billion from the previous quarter’s record $2.13 billion, indicating a shift toward shorter trial contracts rather than long-term commitments. Despite this slowdown, the company raised its full-year guidance, projecting U.S. commercial revenue of at least $3.559 billion for the year.

items.title: Google will let schools disable its AI tools, but not without sacrificing Search
items.summary: 谷歌宣布明年起K-12学生使用Gemini、NotebookLM及Gemini in Classroom需由管理员主动开启，且因Google Search与AI功能深度整合，学校若选择禁用AI将同时失去搜索服务。该调整与谷歌推出的类AI导师工具“Guided Learning”同步发布，旨在帮助学生建立深层理解而非直接获取答案，以应对教育领域对AI破坏学习过程的担忧。

items.title: 苹果的一切都在变贵，全怪 AI
items.summary_en: Apple reported a record-breaking FY2026 with $478.8 billion in total revenue and a $114.47 billion quarterly revenue increase, yet margins are squeezed by unprecedented hardware costs and a 32.5% surge in R&D spending driven by AI infrastructure. To offset the heavy financial burden of processing 2.5 billion daily Siri requests via its Private Cloud Compute, Apple is transitioning its business model by restricting advanced AI features to paid iCloud+ tiers and pushing consumers toward subscription plans. Simultaneously, severe supply chain disruptions in HBM memory have forced the company to drastically raise prices across its product line—including a 56% jump in Mac mini pricing to ¥6,999—and delay the release of its standard iPhone 18 to prioritize high-margin products like the heavily constrained and expensive iPhone Duo.

items.title: Google will turn off search for schools that reject AI
items.summary: 谷歌宣布将关闭拒绝采用人工智能的教育机构的搜索引擎结果展示，这一政策旨在推动AI技术在校园内的全面整合。此举直接改变了学校的数字化访问权限，迫使教育提供方在接入谷歌搜索服务时必须符合其AI优先的战略要求。
items.summary_en: Google is phasing out its Google for Education program for schools that prohibit AI use, ending the service for institutions on its official ban list by September 2025. The platform now requires schools to adopt a "pro-AI" policy, enabling students to use generative tools within Google's Workspace ecosystem for educational tasks.

items.title: AMD 发布 2026 年三季度财报，预计 2027 年营收增长超 80%
items.summary: AMD 2026 年第三季度营收达 133.8 亿美元，同比增长 45%，其中数据中心业务营收创纪录地跃升 97%至 85.5 亿美元，主要由 Instinct GPU 和 EPYC 处理器需求驱动。公司预计 2027 年营收增长超 80%，届时数据中心芯片将贡献 80% 的销售额，且 Meta 正测试首批搭载 MI455X 加速器和“Venice” CPU 的 Helios 系统，以执行其五年内购买最高 600 亿美元 AMD AI 芯片的协议。
items.summary_en: AMD's Q3 2026 revenue rose 45% to a record $13.38 billion, with the data center segment surging 97% to $8.55 billion driven by Instinct GPUs and EPYC processors. The company forecasts 2027 revenue growth of over 80%, significantly above the 77% analyst estimate, as data center chips are projected to constitute 80% of next year's sales. Supporting its Q4 target of $17 billion, AMD is ramping up production of the Helios rack system, which pairs MI455X accelerators with "Venice" CPUs for a massive five-year, up to $60 billion chip supply deal with Meta.

items.title: 纯语音Personal Agent来了！或许，这就是乔布斯心中的Siri
items.summary: 纯语音Personal Agent产品Orilo通过“双层网络”架构解决深度推理与低延迟的技术矛盾，前端轻量化模型实现1.08秒的最快打断响应速度，后端高推理Agent负责执行任务并支持“边干活边闲聊”的无缝交互。其核心创新在于以“早晨”为高频刚需场景切入，结合跨应用上下文能力实现新闻定制解读、长尾信息7×24小时主动监控及一句话闭环操作，体验上优于竞品Muse的被动推送和高延迟交互。
items.topic: AI 工具实操 / Agent 工作流
items.summary_en: Orilo is a voice-first personal AI agent designed to solve the latency and usability issues of text-based assistants by utilizing a dual-layer architecture that separates low-latency frontend interaction from backend reasoning. This structure allows the agent to maintain continuous, natural conversation with sub-1.08-second reaction times while executing complex cross-app tasks, such as automated email management and personalized morning briefings, without interruption.

items.title: Netflix’s new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
items.summary: Netflix 正在美国面向使用英语的电视用户推出“AI Discover”实验性标签页，该功能基于实时响应的智能层，允许用户通过“让我受惊”、“家庭电影之夜”等基于情绪、时长或热门趋势的精选主题来寻找观影内容。用户可点击每个标题旁的“Tune Your Recommendations”按钮来保存偏好或排除特定作品，帮助系统持续学习并优化推荐。
items.summary_en: Netflix is rolling out an experimental "AI Discover" tab in the U.S. for English-speaking users on supported TVs, powered by a new real-time learning intelligence layer. The feature replaces endless scrolling with mood-based curated themes like "quick watches" or "family movie night," allowing users to refine searches and adjust recommendations via a "Tune Your Recommendations" button. Treated as a "test kitchen," the tab will expand to broader audiences based on user feedback before being integrated into the main experience.

directions.name: AI算力债务透视仪
directions.description: 自动解析AI公司S-1/10-K文件及财报中的算力承诺与支出数据，生成可视化债务到期风险仪表盘。
directions.description_en: Automatically parses AI company S-1/10-K filings and financial reports to visualize compute commitment and expenditure risks.
directions.target_user: 关注AI基础设施的独立投资者、风险分析师及科技记者
directions.target_user_en: Independent investors, risk analysts, and tech journalists focused on AI infrastructure
core_features: 自动抓取并结构化解析OpenAI/Anthropic等头部AI公司的S-1/A及财报PDF中的'不可取消算力承诺'字段
基于到期时间轴生成'算力债务悬崖'可视化图表，标记未来4年内到期的巨额支出义务
对比实际融资额（如OpenAI 110亿）与季度成本（如121亿）的缺口，计算'生存跑道'指标
core_features_en: Automatically scrape and structure 'uncancelable compute commitments' from S-1/A and financial PDFs of major AI companies
Generate a 'Compute Debt Cliff' visualization based on maturity timelines, marking massive expenditures due within the next 4 years
Compare actual funding (e.g., OpenAI's $11B) with quarterly costs (e.g., $12.1B) to calculate 'survival runway' metrics
directions.why_now: Reddit和Hacker News社区正热议Ed Zitron关于OpenAI估值融资低于预期（$11B vs 计划更高）且无法覆盖$12.1B季度成本的解析，以及Anthropic S-1文件中披露的$4.3T不可取消算力承诺。社区对'AI公司是否在烧钱找死'的焦虑达到峰值，散户和专业投资者急需一种工具来量化这些隐藏的技术债务风险，而非仅看估值倍数。
directions.why_now_en: Reddit and Hacker News communities are intensely discussing Ed Zitron's analysis of OpenAI's below-plan $11B funding vs. its $12.1B quarterly costs, and Anthropic's S-1 disclosure of $4.3T in uncancellable compute commitments. Community anxiety about 'AI companies burning cash to die' has peaked; retail and professional investors urgently need a tool to quantify these hidden technical debt risks rather than just looking at valuation multiples.
directions.monetization: Freemium SaaS订阅模式，免费用户查看基础趋势图，付费用户（$49/月起）解锁单家公司深度债务拆解报告及API接口。
directions.monetization_en: Freemium SaaS subscription: free users see basic trend charts; paid users ($49+/mo) unlock in-depth debt breakdowns and API access.
directions.source_article: Ed Zitron 解析 OpenAI 1.25 万亿美元估值融资与 Anthropic S-1/A 中的万亿级算力承诺
